verdict.rationale: Elicit's Research Agent and Chat interfaces let users interact via natural-language prompts (e.g., asking questions, adding columns like "Add a column for study type," chatting with papers, and using semantic search instead of keywords), and skills can be invoked via natural language or slash commands. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of natural-language command reliability/robustness (community evidence instead focuses on accuracy/hallucination issues, not command-following), and no evidence of voice or other NL modalities beyond text prompts.
